text:
Jordan: FYI — started seeing a spike of failed GPU node boots in eu-west-1 around 09:04 UTC. failures are KMS decrypt errors during instance-init, looks like a policy rejection.
Maya: ugh, which key? service account or node bootstrap role?
Jordan: node-bootstrap-key (arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/abcd1234). stacktrace snippet from node: `Error decrypting data key: AccessDeniedException`
Samir: that key rotation we talked about yesterday? did the cross-account grant get rolled?
Lee: Not that I saw. I checked key policy — it still lists our infra role, but the account-level IAM condition for VPC endpoint principals became stricter in the audit PR.
Maya: Could be the subnet change too; recall we moved warm-pool nodes to a shared-subnet with stricter source vpc restrictions.
Jordan: Logs show node attempted to hit KMS via privatelink endpoint -> TLS handshake OK -> KMS returned AccessDenied.
Samir: ops-bot, can you pull the last KMS policy diff and the privatelink endpoint SG events?
ops-bot: pulled diff: https://internal.example.com/diffs/kr-1718. Policy change: added `Condition: StringEquals: {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0c1d2e3f"}`. Privatelink endpoint VPC is vpc-0f1e2d3c.
Lee: ah, policy now restricts SourceVpc to our primary VPC, but warm-pool uses the shared-subnet VPC. mismatch = AccessDenied.
Maya: mitigation options: 1) relax policy to allow both VPCs, 2) add a cross-account grant for the shared subnet role, 3) move warm-pool back (painful).
Jordan: short-term prefer option 1 with narrow condition: allow both vpc-ids and specific source principals (node-bootstrap-role).
Samir: agree, but we need audit trail. Make the change as emergency and tag for postmortem. Also add an allow with `Condition: IpAddress` for the privatelink ENIs as extra safeguard.
Maya: I'll open an emergency PR with the policy tweak and include the exact GRANT line. PR will include minimal TTL (30m) window and automated revert job.
Lee: also notify Dedicated customers in eu-west-1; capacity may degrade while we recover. Jordan, can you estimate impacted GPUs?
Jordan: ~120 GPUs in warm pools currently failing to join; active pools still fine, but autoscaling is throttled. If we don't fix in 20m users will see longer queue times.
Samir: tagging finance: this will spike burst costs if we start spinning reserve nodes in other regions without data locality.
Maya: PR linked: https://git.internal/infrastructure/policies/pulls/998 — title: emergency/kms-policy-allow-shared-vpc. request: review + /merge by ops-sre.
ops-bot: deploy triggered for policy change to eu-west-1 (canary). watch logs: `kms-decrypt-success` metric # increased from 0 -> 1 after patch applied to canary.
Jordan: canary looks good, nodes in 2 warm pools booted and joined within 90s.
Lee: rollback window is 30m. Postmortem owner? Samir volunteered.
Samir: noted. capture timeline, decision rationale, and follow-up: add CI test to validate KMS policy vs privatelink VPCs.
Maya: also add alert: kms-access-denied-in-bootstrap -> page on rate >3 in 5m.
Jordan: thanks all. I'll update the customer status page and ping sales ops.
Maya: :thumbsup:
